blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) is seeking to simplify export procedures and help Filipino businesses overcome regulatory and customs hurdles in accessing international markets. The bureau discussed customs processes, free trade agreements, and government support programs during its first-ever Export Summit held on Oct. 26 and 27, according to a BOC statement on Sunday. Organized in coordination with the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) and the Department of Agriculture (DA), the summit sought to address challenges faced by local businesses in understanding export regulations, complying with requirements, and taking advantage of existing trade agreements.
